title: Esther Becomes Queen
reflectionQuestion: Esther was just an ordinary girl, and God had a special plan for her all along. I wonder what wonderful plans God might have for someone like you?
kidSafetyNotes: Claims OPEN registry anchor esther_queen (Esther 2; was short-only -> now short+full). DELIBERATELY DISTINCT from 1838 Esther's Brave Choice (Esther 4-8): this is the BECOMING (ordinary orphan girl chosen -> queen), NOT the brave plea/Haman, which 1838 owns. Adam's tweak baked in: full fairy-tale register -- opens 'Once there was a girl named Esther' (NOT 'orphan living in exile'); palace, beautiful clothes, big doors, kind heart. Orphanhood named gently ('no mother or father of her own... but she was not alone'). Danger only hinted at the end as a bridge to 1838, kept light. End line per Adam: 'Nobody knew it yet... but God had a special plan for Esther... a story for another day.' VOICE_JANE_PROFESSIONAL (regal/court register, distinct from 1838's Esther voice so the pair sounds different).
